00043 class SimpleConvolutionUGenInternal : public UGenInternal
00044 {
00045 public:
00046     SimpleConvolutionUGenInternal(UGen const& inputA, 
00047                                   UGen const& inputB, 
00048                                   const int fftSize, 
00049                                   const int initialDelay) throw();
00050     ~SimpleConvolutionUGenInternal();
00051     UGenInternal* getChannel(const int channel) throw();
00052     void processBlock(bool& shouldDelete, const unsigned int blockID, const int channel) throw();
00053     
00054     enum Inputs { InputA, InputB, NumInputs };
00055     
00056     inline void MultAndAdd(DSPSplitComplex& In1, DSPSplitComplex& In2, DSPSplitComplex& Out, const int VecLength) const throw()
00057     {
00058         vFloat *InReal1 = (vFloat *) In1.realp;
00059         vFloat *InImag1 = (vFloat *) In1.imagp;
00060         vFloat *InReal2 = (vFloat *) In2.realp;
00061         vFloat *InImag2 = (vFloat *) In2.imagp;
00062         vFloat *OutReal = (vFloat *) Out.realp;
00063         vFloat *OutImag = (vFloat *) Out.imagp;
00064         ZEROINIT
00065         
00066         float Nyquist1, Nyquist2;
00067         Nyquist1 = In1.imagp[0];
00068         Nyquist2 = In2.imagp[0];
00069         
00070         In1.imagp[0] = 0.f;
00071         In2.imagp[0] = 0.f;
00072         
00073         Out.imagp[0] += Nyquist1 * Nyquist2;
00074         
00075         for (int i = 0; i < VecLength; i++)
00076         {
00077             OutReal[i] = VEC_ADD_OP (OutReal[i], VEC_SUB_OP (VEC_MUL_OP(InReal1[i], InReal2[i] ZEROARG), VEC_MUL_OP(InImag1[i], InImag2[i] ZEROARG)));
00078             OutImag[i] = VEC_ADD_OP (OutImag[i], VEC_ADD_OP (VEC_MUL_OP(InReal1[i], InImag2[i] ZEROARG), VEC_MUL_OP(InImag1[i], InReal2[i] ZEROARG)));
00079         }
00080         
00081         In1.imagp[0] = Nyquist1;
00082         In2.imagp[0] = Nyquist2;
00083     }
00084     
00085     enum Buffers
00086     {
00087         InputBufferA = InputA, 
00088         InputBufferB = InputB, 
00089         ProcessA, ProcessB, FFTResult, Output, NumBuffers
00090     };
00091     
00092     
00093 protected:
00094     const int fftSize_;
00095     const int fftSizeHalved;
00096     const int initialDelay_;
00097     FFTEngineInternal *fftEngine;
00098     Buffer buffers;
00099     int bufferIndex;
00100     
00101 };
